سیٹنگزSettings

کسٹمر کی معلوماتCustomer Information

Ye aapke apne business/customer ki details hain — inhi ke mutabiq Sale/Purchase/Token slip aur PDF ka header banega.
Ye logo Sale/Purchase/Token slip ke UPAR (header) mein aapke business ke naam ke sath dikhega.

Receipt (Thermal Slip)

Yahan jo Shop Name, Shop Address aur Shop Phone Number likhenge, wahi thermal Slip (POS printer) ke sabse upar print hoga. Khaali chorein to upar wali "Shop Name/Address/Mobile" hi use ho jayegi.

پی ڈی ایف لیٹر ہیڈPDF Letterhead (Optional)

Agar aapke paas apna designed letterhead (poora A4 background — logo/border/design sab kuch shamil) hai, to yahan upload kar dein. PDF reports (Ledger, P&L waghera) isi ko background ki tarah use karenge. Upload na karein to normal simple header/footer chalta rahega.
Ye margins batate hain ke aapke letterhead design ke UPAR/NEECHE kitni jagah khaali chorein taake data usse na takraye. A4 page 297mm lamba hota hai.
Har slip/PDF ke neeche "Powered By SHAH GROUP" branding fixed hai aur isay change nahi kiya ja sakta.

Notifications

Supabase Edge Function URL

Edge Function deploy karne ke baad yahan URL paste karein
Ye wahi value honi chahiye jo Supabase par supabase secrets set API_KEY=... se set ki hai. Isse koi bhi random banda aap ka Edge Function use nahi kar sakega — sirf yahi app.

Product Data Check

Agar koi item Sale/Stock mein nahi dikh raha, ye check chala kar khud pata laga sakte hain — Supabase ke "products" table mein khaali ID, duplicate ID, ya ghalat Stock jaisi problems khud-ba-khud dhoond kar dikha dega.

All Data Import (Excel se poora data)

Purane backup ki Excel file (Products, Customers, Suppliers, Sales, Purchases, Tokens waghera sab sheets) upload karo — ek hi Save se sab data Supabase me chala jayega. Agar Supabase me pehle se koi data hai to import nahi hoga: pehle Hard Reset karna hoga. Sirf Admin kar sakta hai.
